source: SAS Container Runtime: Programming and Administration Guide, 2026.09 (Appendix 2; chapters 4, 5, 7 and 8)

groups.label: SAS Container Runtime: DS2 and database logging
SAS Container Runtime: requests and responses
SAS Container Runtime: content security policy
Python model runtime: logging
groups.note: Read by Python model images built on the 2026.07 runtime or later; older images ignore them. Levels must be in upper case.

groups.label: R model runtime: logging
groups.note: Read by R model images built on the 2026.07 runtime or later.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_SCR_IO
entries.description: At TRACE, logs the input and output values of every request.
entries.note: The log then contains the scored data.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_STRUCTURED
entries.description: true writes the log as JSON lines instead of plain text.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_App.tk.MAS
entries.description: The runtime's core engine (shared with SAS Micro Analytic Service).

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_App.tk.MAS.Service
entries.description: At DEBUG or TRACE, logs start-up and shutdown events.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_SCR_PROFILE
entries.description: Sampled timings: compilation at DEBUG; compilation and execution at TRACE.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_SCR_MEM_CODE
entries.description: At DEBUG, logs the engine's memory use while it compiles the module code.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_SCR_MEM_NATIVE
entries.description: At DEBUG, logs the engine's memory use while it runs the module code.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_SCR_CONFIG
entries.description: Configuration processing, including how the logging set-up is built.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_SCR_MODULE_LOGGER
entries.description: Module creation.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_SCR_ENV
entries.description: At TRACE, logs the container's environment variables.
entries.note: Values are logged too, including any secrets passed as variables.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_App.tk.MAS.Python
entries.description: The interface that runs Python code called from DS2.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_App.tk.MAS.ParallelExec
entries.description: The DS2 MASParallelExec package (parallel sub-decisions).

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_App.tk.MAS.Thread
entries.description: How worker threads are picked for requests.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_App.TableServices.DS2.Runtime.Put
entries.description: Output of PUT statements in the DS2 code.
entries.note: The guide does not say which level turns this on; TRACE shows the most.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_App.TableServices.DS2.Runtime.Log
entries.description: Messages the DS2 code writes to the SAS log.
entries.note: The guide does not say which level turns this on; TRACE shows the most.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_App.TableServices.DS2.Runtime.Calls
entries.description: A trace of every method call while the DS2 code runs.
entries.note: The guide does not say which level turns this on; TRACE shows the most.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_App.TableServices.DS2.Runtime.Timing
entries.description: Time spent parsing, compiling and running the DS2 code (more detail at DEBUG and TRACE).

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_App.TableServices.DS2.Runtime.SQL
entries.description: SQL statements that the DS2 code prepares or runs.
entries.note: The guide does not say which level turns this on; TRACE shows the most.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_App.SQLServices.API
entries.description: Database connection and statement activity; it must be DEBUG for that to be logged.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_LOG_LEVEL_Audit.Table.Connection
entries.description: Database connections.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_METRICS
entries.description: true adds execution metrics (number and duration of calls) to /prometheus. By default it shows system metrics only.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_PROMETHEUS_ENABLED
entries.description: false turns the metrics endpoint off.
entries.note: The SCR endpoint page in MAS Scorer reads its metrics from /prometheus.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_PROMETHEUS_ENDPOINT
entries.description: The path of the metrics endpoint.
entries.note: The SCR endpoint page in MAS Scorer only reads /prometheus.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_PROMETHEUS_RATE
entries.description: How often metric data is collected, in milliseconds.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_INPUT_SCORE_VARIABLE
entries.description: An input variable whose values /prometheus tracks as a histogram. Needs SAS_SCR_METRICS=true.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_OUTPUT_SCORE_VARIABLE
entries.description: An output variable (for example a probability) whose values /prometheus tracks as a histogram. Needs SAS_SCR_METRICS=true.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_INPUT_SCORE_MAX
entries.description: The top of the input-score histogram. Larger values all land in one overflow bin.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_OUTPUT_SCORE_MAX
entries.description: The top of the output-score histogram. Larger values all land in one overflow bin.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_SCORE_BINS
entries.description: The number of bins in the score histograms.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_JSON_REQUIRE_MISSING_INPUT
entries.description: true requires every input in each request (null allowed). With false, inputs left out are scored as null.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_JSON_NULL_OUTPUT
entries.description: true returns every output, including those that are null. With false, null outputs are left out of the response.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_JSON_STRIP_TRAILING_UNDERSCORE
entries.description: SAS Intelligent Decisioning gives input variables a trailing underscore. true drops it from the input names in the signature and in requests; false keeps it.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_PASS_HEADERS
entries.description: true passes request headers that start with sas-custom- to the model as metadata.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_REST_CONTENT_APPLICATION_JSON
entries.description: true answers with Content-Type application/json when the request accepts it, instead of the SAS media type.
entries.note: Documented for SAS Container Runtime 2026.09. Images built on older releases ignore it (SCR 1.804.22 does).

entries.name: SAS_SCR_CORE_NUM_THREADS
entries.description: Threads that serve requests. More threads take more requests at once, but use more memory and can slow start-up.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_CORE_NUM_ASYNC_THREADS
entries.description: Threads for background work that the code queues with asyncCallModule.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_CORE_MAX_PE_THREADS
entries.description: Threads for the MASParallelExec package. Any number above 0 turns parallel execution of sub-decisions on.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_CORE_PE_WAIT_TIME_MILLISECONDS
entries.description: How long the parallel-execution wait method waits, in milliseconds. 0 waits until all calls are done.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_CSP_FRAME_ANCESTORS
entries.description: Which pages may embed the container's pages in a frame. Separate several sources with spaces, for example 'self' https://*.example.com.

entries.name: SAS_SCR_CSP_FORM_ACTION
entries.description: Which addresses forms may submit to. Separate several sources with spaces.

entries.description: Scoring.
